in_marathi.name: Hapijul
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hapijul हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hapijul is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘hap’ meaning ‘joy’ and ‘ijul’ meaning ‘grace from the gods’. This name signifies the divine grace bestowed upon a child.
